title: Probe ordered after man dies in struggle with police
article: A medical examiner has ordered an inquiry into the sudden death of a man being arrested under suspicion he had been ringing doorbells in his underwear in freezing temperatures.
Kenneth Gordon Holt, 39, was arrested by five Red Deer RCMP officers early Thursday on the front lawn of a house.
An autopsy yesterday did not determine a cause of death except to indicate it was not foul play. The medical examiner is awaiting results of a toxicology test.
Police had been waiting with Mr. Holt for an ambulance to arrive, said RCMP.
Mr. Holt seemed fine but at one point he stopped struggling with police and shortly afterward they discovered he had stopped breathing.
